drafts.draft_en: AI built this 3D VFX shot in an afternoon. No modeling, no rigging, no render farm. Just one prompt, a few corrections, and my eye on the final frame. Scary how fast this got 👀 Breakdown below.
drafts.video_tip: 12-15s: open on the finished cinematic 3D shot, then a fast rewind through the steps (prompt, rough blockout, textured pass, final comp). On-screen timer '3 hrs' in a corner. Prompt and tools in reply 1.

drafts.draft_en:
Prompt share: cinematic VFX shot in loose watercolor 🎨

[Subject] caught in [VFX event], loose oversized brushstrokes, soft pigment bleeding, wet-on-wet texture, slow camera drift, film grain, no outlines. Swap the brackets and show me yours.
drafts.video_tip: 4-image grid of the same template (dragon over a city, collapsing bridge, portal, storm at sea), then a 5s animated version of the best one in Kling 4.0 or Seedance 2.5.

drafts.draft_en: Saturday Challenge 🎬 Pick a song, pick a decade, make the music video that never existed. Mine: Thriller (1928), silent film edition. Drop yours below, best one gets featured next week.
drafts.video_tip: 12-15s, 1.33:1 black and white, heavy flicker and grain, silent-film title cards between 3 beat-synced cuts, end card 'THRILLER (1928)'. Rules pinned in reply 1, ask for song suggestions.

drafts.draft_en: From a flat 2D sketch to a full 3D VFX character in one pass. Same design, same colors, now it moves, casts shadows and lives in a real scene. Which character should I bring to 3D next?
drafts.video_tip: 10s: 2s on the flat 2D drawing, a wipe or paper-fold transition into the 3D version turning its head, then 4s of it inside a lit cinematic environment. Ask for the next character in the caption to drive replies.

drafts.draft_en: I made this VFX sequence in about 2 hours and didn't touch a timeline. I described each shot to an AI agent, fixed 3 things, and it built the cut. The speed is wild, but taste is still the job.
drafts.video_tip: Split screen: left your typed shot descriptions appearing one by one, right the sequence updating after each instruction. 12s, end with a clean 3s play of the final cut and a '2 hrs' label.
